title: Gordon Novel shows UFO propulsion drawings at the International UFO Congress
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Gordon Novel shows UFO propulsion drawings at the International UFO Congress, about 1994 at Washington, D.C., and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: 1994 I'm out you know representing Dr John Mack and I was asked to do a presentation of the international UFO Congress uh so I'm doing a report on the international UFO Congress and all of a sudden Gordon Noel walks up out of the crowd and says Oh Mr Shen he said look you know I've got I've got all these uh drawings and stuff about the UFOs and how their propulsion system works

plain: Dan Sheehan, a lawyer who says he was representing a doctor named John Mack, says that in 1994 he was giving a presentation at the International UFO Congress, a gathering of UFO researchers. He says a man named Gordon Novel walked up out of the crowd and told him he had drawings showing how UFOs are propelled. If true, it would mean someone was offering inside knowledge of how such craft fly.
